policy: Internal notes and approved anchors remain in canonical/export data. Reader strips anchors and presents exact explanations through inconspicuous verse-click About this wording panel; no visible footnote chrome. Hiding is renderer behavior, not deleting internal references.

notes.exact_text: The actual printed132 star before all is retained. The133 continuation is the relative expression ዘበኅቡእ, not the adjective copied in the first author draft. Primary Dillmann600–601 supports hidden/secret and the adverbial in-secret construction. The singular carried-me verb is retained without identifying a new angel carrier.

Easily melted metal renders ነጠብጣብ by its primary lexical description, metallum quod facile liquescit, not by an undisclosed identification with a modern alloy. Copper is the ordinary metal sense of ጸሪቅ, also used for bronze; the final ዐረር is lead. This is a list of six mountains, not a numeral printed in the source.

The final selected expression is በኅቡእ, in secret, not the first draft misreading በግቡእ. Actual Dillmann600–601 gives the hidden/secret range and in-occulto construction. The first-person I saw and accompanying angel remain unchanged; this is a glyph correction from the actual primary photo, not adoption of another textual witness.

The selected noun is Anointed One, and the purpose verbs are command and exercise power. No later personal name is inserted. Serve the authority renders the purpose relation, not an additional act of worship.

The selected final verb is ዘከለለ, not the first draft miscopy ዘተለለ. Actual Dillmann816 gives the enclose/encircle sense under ከለለ; the rendering surrounded is retained. The selected wording is not replaced with the planted reading reported in Charles95 note28. Wait-a-little and will-be-revealed retain their force.

The dagger and selected stars remain. The final actual expression is before his feet; the first draft extra suffix on before is removed. Primary Dillmann207 controls honey, and1153 explicitly gives the honey-plus-wild compound as cera, wax. Easily melted metal uses the primary697 description rather than an undisclosed modern alloy identification.
Both negatives are retained. The source does not name a new subject here; they carries forward the people implicit in the judgment context, not an additional proper name.

The armor clause remains provisional; shoulder renders the visible አንገድዓ rather than dropping it. The selected armor form is ለድርዖ. All selected negatives, including bracketed ኢይበቅዖ ወ, are kept in meaning. Primary665 gives ናእክ a lead/tin range; tin distinguishes it provisionally from separate ዐረር lead. The exact printed following verb and its meaning require independent recheck; have no value is not certified. No reported variant is adopted to repair this unit.

Denied and is bracketed in the selected source, not added from a newly inspected manuscript. The proposal includes its sense and preserves the remainder destroyed/from-earth/Chosen-One/before-Lord. The infinitival being expression is rendered as destruction of their existence rather than omitted as a separate event.

The selected አስተያ belongs to drinking vocabulary (bibere/potio/potus) in actual primary Dillmann365–366. Drink offerings is a contextual rendering within this gift/offerings list, not an assertion that the lexicon establishes a particular libation ritual; generic presents obscures the drinking sense. The source piles up dwellers, gifts/drink offerings/offerings and people bringing them. English joins the clauses without adding a destination or naming recipients. The final not-be-filled negative and dry land, sea and islands are retained.

This is a deliberately provisional rendering. The offering/toiling/devouring relations are difficult. The source brackets the repeated sinners and the negative ኢ before come-to-an-end. This proposal keeps the bracketed negative in English rather than silently producing the opposite meaning. Being driven away follows primary Dillmann 453 abigi, segregari, explicitly citing this verse; it is not interpreted as successfully standing against the Lord.

Instrument is provisional for the selected መባልዕተ, whose printed form differs from common clothing/equipment words. The source says for Satan, not explicitly Satan himself manufacturing tools. No additional torture inventory is inserted.
The equipment noun is retained as instruments provisionally, in continuity with 53:3. The selected question is for whom, not what purpose or what materials.
The kings/mighty of this earth and destruction are explicit. By them conveys the means relation to the objects being prepared; it does not add a named executioner.

The selected text has righteousness, not a silently substituted righteous person. Its relation to the Chosen One and the following house of assembly is unresolved. The assembly compound has primary congregation/meeting support, but that does not settle the syntax. The negative will not be withheld and both after-this expressions are retained.

The initial negative ኢ is visibly present and retained. The selected phrase like the earth is not silently changed into flat earth, nor is the negative dropped to match another version. Suffering caused by sinners uses the primary injury/misery range of ጻማ with its genitive. The mountains/earth comparison still needs syntactic review.
The narrator remains first person. Another region renders another face of the earth; fire is explicit and no named underworld location is added.
The source does not name the subject of they brought/cast in this verse. No new angel is inserted; both kings and mighty are retained.
Iron bonds and no measure are explicit. Weight is a provisional interpretation of the selected final measuring noun, and the equipment form has the same unresolved problem as 53:3–4.

The selected source brackets the second noun as an explanatory gloss, according to the actual printed98 note1. Bonds is the concrete sense of the rare አስራት discussed by Charles on printed97 note44; the primary lexical binding range is consistent. Instruments is provisional for the bracketed noun and is not erased from the proposal.

The actual jaw form is መልታሒሆሙ; first-draft መልታሕቶሙ was a transcription error. Primary Dillmann45 explicitly cites54:5 for the jaw noun. The selected adjective has the primary1241 curved/twisted range, rendered crooked rather than inventing a rough texture or replacing jaws with faces. Primary225 supports the passive hand-over sense;1007 supports host/group. No fresh manuscript or extra textual reading is claimed.

The four selected Ethiopic names are retained, including Rufael and Phanuel. Primary Dillmann1290 explicitly cites54:6 under strict holding, apprehending, restraining, supporting seize here rather than strengthen them. Belonged to Satan renders the selected became/were for Satan without adding the noun servants. The furnace/casting and dry-land-dwellers relations remain complete.

The whole flood section begins with an editorial bracket here and continues beyond chapter54; that opening bracket is retained without falsely closing the section at this verse. A separate inner bracket encloses and above the gates that are beneath the heavens. This deliberately awkward proposal includes that printed phrase; the actual98 note34 calls it a marginal gloss and describes its reported textual construction. No reported reading is adopted to smooth it. The storehouse/gate syntax remains unresolved.

The source changes number and gender in describing the waters; English keeps the male/female distinction instead of replacing it with modern hydrology. The relative ዘ before with is bracketed. The mingling relation and whether all-waters functions as the subject need syntactic review; the primary mixture and male/female senses are controlled.
The selected wiping-out verb is retained, controlled by the primary erase/destroy range. Beneath the ends of heaven is not silently changed to a different geographic phrase or only the land.

This is a literal provisional construal of the selected knowledge verb and wrongdoing expression. The actual99 note12 discusses a Greek reconstruction, not an extant Greek manuscript inspected here. That printed reconstruction is not adopted as translation input. The final by-it feminine relation is retained provisionally; the clause must not be freely replaced with they recognized their wrongdoing after judgment.
